data.rationale: The proposed workflow follows the same procedure in the same order (Cars tab, pick-up, drop-off, dates, times, Search, filters, sort), but it replaces the generic filters and sort parameters with specific car_type, capacity and rental_company, and it makes sort optional without naming a parameter, so a browser automation could be built from it with only minor gaps.
